tasks.title: Add getWorktreeStatus() to WorktreeManager
tasks.description: Add a `getWorktreeStatus(projectPath, projectName, issueNumber, baseBranch)` method to WorktreeManager that uses `git rev-list --left-right --count <baseBranch>...<issueBranch>` to compute ahead/behind counts. Returns `{ exists, branch, ahead, behind, canFastForward, isRebaseInProgress }`. Reuse existing `isRebaseInProgress()` and `exists()` methods. Export a `WorktreeStatus` interface.
acceptanceCriteria: getWorktreeStatus returns { exists: true, branch, ahead, behind, canFastForward, isRebaseInProgress } for existing worktree
getWorktreeStatus returns { exists: false, branch: '', ahead: 0, behind: 0, canFastForward: false, isRebaseInProgress: false } when worktree does not exist
canFastForward is derived as behind === 0
WorktreeStatus interface is exported
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Design D4: use git rev-list --left-right --count. The three-dot syntax (baseBranch...issueBranch) gives left=ahead, right=behind.

tasks.title: Add GET worktree-status endpoint and rebase queue to API
tasks.description: Add `GET /:number/worktree-status` route in createIssueRoutes that calls worktreeManager.getWorktreeStatus(). Then modify the existing `POST /:number/rebase` route to accept a `queue` query param: when agent is running and queue=true, store entry in an in-memory Map and return `{ queued: true }`. Register an `agent_completed` EventBus listener in createIssueRoutes that checks the queue map and triggers the existing rebase logic for queued entries. When queue=true but agent is not running, execute rebase directly.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status returns 200 with { exists, branch, ahead, behind, canFastForward, isRebaseInProgress } when worktree exists
GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status returns 200 with { exists: false, ... } when worktree does not exist
GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status returns 404 when issue does not exist
POST /rebase?queue=true returns { queued: true } when agent is running and stage supports rebase
POST /rebase?queue=true executes rebase directly when agent is not running
POST /rebase?queue=true returns 400 when stage is backlog/explore
POST /rebase (no queue) returns 409 when agent is running (existing behavior preserved)
Queued rebase auto-executes after agent_completed event fires
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Design D3: queue is an in-memory Map<number, {issueNumber, projectId}> in createIssueRoutes closure. The agent_completed listener checks and drains queued entries.

tasks.title: Add frontend API methods and useWorktreeStatus hook
tasks.description: Add `getWorktreeStatus(number)` method to api.ts calling `GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status`. Extend `rebaseIssue(number)` to accept optional `{ queue: boolean }` param, appending `?queue=true` query param when set. Add `useWorktreeStatus(issueNumber)` hook in useQueries.ts with queryKey `['worktree-status', issueNumber]`, enabled only when issueNumber > 0. Add `['worktree-status', issueNumber]` invalidation to SSE rebase_completed and rebase_conflict handlers in useSSE.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: api.getWorktreeStatus(number) sends GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status and returns WorktreeStatus
api.rebaseIssue(number, { queue: true }) sends POST /api/issues/:number/rebase?queue=true
api.rebaseIssue(number) without options works as before (backward compatible)
useWorktreeStatus(issueNumber) uses queryKey ['worktree-status', issueNumber]
SSE rebase_completed/rebase_conflict events invalidate ['worktree-status'] queries
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli/web && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Design D5: no polling for useWorktreeStatus, SSE-driven refresh only. The hook follows existing useIssue pattern in useQueries.ts.

tasks.title: Create WorktreePanel component
tasks.description: Create WorktreePanel.tsx component that displays branch name, ahead/behind status (Up to date in green, behind in amber, ahead count), and a rebase button. Button shows 'Rebase onto master' when agent is idle, 'Rebase after completion' when agent is running (passing queue=true). Display rebase result feedback (success/info/error/queued). Show SSE rebase progress (rebase_started, rebase_progress, rebase_completed, rebase_conflict). Props: issueNumber, isAgentRunning. Uses useWorktreeStatus hook.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel shows branch name from useWorktreeStatus
ahead=0, behind=0 shows green 'Up to date' indicator
behind>0 shows amber 'N commits behind master' with highlighted rebase button
ahead>0 shows 'N commits ahead of master'
Combined ahead+behind shows 'N ahead, M behind master'
Agent idle: button says 'Rebase onto master', calls rebaseIssue without queue
Agent running: button says 'Rebase after completion', calls rebaseIssue with { queue: true }
Rebase result feedback: success (green), info/up-to-date (blue), error/conflicts (red with file list), queued (blue)
SSE rebase events update panel progress state
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli/web && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Follow existing panel styling (rounded-md border, space-y-4 sidebar layout). The component is self-contained with all hooks internal.

tasks.title: Integrate WorktreePanel and remove stage-specific rebase buttons
tasks.description: In IssueDetailPage.tsx: (1) Import and render WorktreePanel after MergeStatePanel, before Review Report. Pass issueNumber and isAgentRunning props. (2) Remove the Build stage rebase button block (~line 639-659). (3) Remove the Review approval gate rebase button block (~line 798-831). (4) Remove the Plan approval gate rebase button block (~line 850-882). (5) Remove the standalone rebaseResult display in Actions panel (~line 743-758). (6) Remove rebaseResult state and rebaseMutation (now handled inside WorktreePanel). Do NOT touch MergeStatePanel.
acceptanceCriteria: WorktreePanel renders in sidebar after MergeStatePanel, before Review Report section
No 'Rebase onto master' button exists in Actions panel for Build stage
No rebase button exists inside Plan approval gate section
No rebase button exists inside Review approval gate section
No rebaseResult state or rebaseMutation in IssueDetailPage
MergeStatePanel 'Rebase and Retry' button is unchanged
WorktreePanel is visible for all stages with worktrees (plan/build/review/done, including interrupted)
WorktreePanel is hidden for backlog/explore stages
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli/web && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Design D1: panel order is Details → Pipeline Interrupted → Actions → MergeStatePanel → WorktreePanel → Review Report → Approval Required. Design D2: visibility driven by worktree-status API response { exists }.
